title: Payment sandbox intermittently slow under concurrent load
description: Multiple test runs report ReadTimeout against api.paymentsvc.internal during nightly regression when run in parallel with load tests. Vendor confirmed sandbox has lower throughput than production.
resolution: Coordinated with vendor to get a dedicated QA sandbox tier; also raised client timeout defensively.

title: Connection pool exhaustion in inventory-integration suite
description: inventory-integration suite fails intermittently with connection timeouts after ~40 tests run, recovers after CI worker restart. Suspected connection leak.
resolution: Root-caused to a test missing a finally-block DB close; fixed and added a pool-size assertion to CI as a guardrail.

title: Discount stacking produces incorrect totals for promo+flat combos
description: Customer support escalation: two customers reported checkout total $0.90 higher than expected when a percentage promo and a flat-dollar coupon were both applied.
resolution: Confirmed bug in discount ordering logic, same root cause identified independently by QA in test_price_calculation_discount_stacking.

title: CI image update broke PDF report generation across all report suites
description: After base CI image bump to ubuntu:24.04, all reporting-integration jobs began failing with missing binary errors.
resolution: Explicit dependency installation added to pipeline; recommend auditing other suites for undeclared system dependencies.

title: SMS vendor sandbox rate limit causing notification test flakiness
description: notifications-integration suite fails ~15% of runs with HTTP 429 from SMS vendor when full suite runs in parallel across 8 xdist workers.
resolution: Rate limiter fixture added; flakiness dropped to 0% over 50 subsequent runs.

title: Currency rounding discrepancy after checkout refactor
description: QA flagged sub-cent rounding differences in EUR/GBP totals after the checkout money-handling refactor (PR #2291) switched from Decimal to float internally.
resolution: Refactor reverted to Decimal arithmetic; added property-based rounding tests to prevent recurrence.

title: Search ranking golden fixtures stale after relevance model update
description: QA test failures on ranking assertions after search relevance model v3 rollout. Search team confirms ranking changes are intentional.
resolution: Established a process requiring search-relevance model changes to be tagged in the release changelog so QA can proactively refresh golden fixtures.
